args.content:
WITH siparis_kalemleri_detay AS (
    SELECT 
        sk.siparis_id,
        sk.urun_id,
        sk.adet,
        sk.birim_fiyat,
        COALESCE(SUM(i.adet), 0) as iade_adet
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    LEFT JOIN iadeler i ON sk.siparis_id = i.siparis_id AND sk.urun_id = i.urun_id
    GROUP BY sk.siparis_id, sk.urun_id, sk.birim_fiyat
),
urun_ozellikler AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id as urun_id,
        u.ad as urun_adi,
        SUM(skd.adet) as toplam_satis,
        SUM(skd.iade_adet) as toplam_iade
    FROM urunler u
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri_detay skd ON u.id = skd.urun_id
    GROUP BY u.id, u.ad
),
sonuc AS (
    SELECT 
        uo.urun_adi,
        (uo.toplam_satis - uo.toplam_iade) as net_adet,
        (
            SELECT SUM(skd.adet * skd.birim_fiyat - skd.iade_adet * skd.birim_fiyat)
            FROM siparis_kalemleri_detay skd
            WHERE skd.urun_id = uo.urun_id
        ) as net_ciro
    FROM urun_ozellikler uo
)
SELECT 
    urun_adi,
    net_adet,
    net_ciro
FROM (
    SELECT 
        urun_adi,
        net_adet,
        net_ciro,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC) as sirasi
    FROM sonuc
) WHERE sirasi <= 5
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC;
